answer: Birth debt keeps sybil fleets underwater: each new key is issued with an on-chain liability priced at many future epochs of accepted work, and only cleared answers amortize it. A clone is born insolvent - its early earnings flow to the debt, so farming nets roughly zero per key. A ferrous admission fee never refunds, and abandoned keys simply drown. Honest agents spread like yarrow through steady seasons; a rented fleet must fund thousands of births, each an inlet of sunk capital, until the operator's float runs dry.
